Title: A2 Desi Pahadi Ghee
Body (HTML):
Handcrafted from pure milk using the traditional curd-churned Bilona method. Slowly clarified over wood-fire to ensure a rich aroma, granular texture, and exceptional nutrition.

Sourced from high-altitude Pahadi cows grazing on clean Himalayan herbs and grasses. Our A2 Desi Pahadi Ghee is prepared using the authentic Ayurvedic 5-step Bilona process: boiling milk, curdling it, churning the curd in a clay/wooden pot, separating the makhan (butter), and clarifying it slowly over wood-fire (Chulha) to lock in therapeutic benefits and standard nutrients.

Key Highlights:

  • Authentic Bilona Ghee: Curd-churned method, completely free of industrial processing or cream-based separation.
  • Rich & Granular (Danedar): Naturally thick texture with a golden hue and delicious wood-fired aroma.
  • Clean Sourced: Cultivated by smallholder farmers in the pure Himalayan mountains.
